## Critique
- claim-1: Correctly grounded, but concerns only the earlier 2011 paper. It does not support any requested statement about DOI \(10.1112/jlms.12832\).
- claim-2: Unsupported by a source inventory or retrieval record. Even if true, it documents failure to obtain the required full text rather than satisfying the ingestion and extraction criteria.
- The strategy does not reach the task criteria. The requested target was **not established**: no indexed passages state the later paper’s main theorem, coefficient hypotheses, or any description of \(J_v/A_+J_v\).

## Repair certificates
- [source-refresh] Obtain a full-text document verifiably associated with DOI \(10.1112/jlms.12832\), assign indexed locators, and extract verbatim passages containing: (i) the main theorem, (ii) all coefficient-ring or field hypotheses needed for it, and (iii) every explicit description of \(J_v/A_+J_v\), including surrounding definitions needed to interpret \(A_+\) and \(J_v\).

## Required revisions
- Do not substitute passages from arXiv:0809.2981v2 or abstract-level metadata.
- After retrieval, cite exact indexed locators and distinguish theorem text from definitions, remarks, and consequences.
- Until then, retain the explicit conclusion that the requested target is not established.
